tools_helpful.evidence: Bootstrap copied all .xaml/.cs/.resw/.appxmanifest and produced the mapping table (session-log lines 323-358); files landed correctly.

tools_problematic.problem: Passes a manifest that still carries UWP-only <Extension Category="windows.backgroundTasks" EntryPoint=...> blocks, which then fail AppX registration at launch with 0x80080204. The validator only checks TargetDeviceFamily/rescap/runFullTrust, not background-task extensions.
tools_problematic.evidence: migration-score.json winui_launch_error: 'error 0x80080204 - App manifest validation error, Package.appxmanifest line 31: EntryPoint=BackgroundTask.GeofenceBackgroundTask without ActivatableClassId in windows.activatableClass.inProcessServer'. Build was clean (0 errors) so no gate caught it.

tool_limitations.limitation: Did not run / did not catch the registration failure in the dev trial (build was clean, app never verified to launch), so the manifest defect reached scoring.
tool_limitations.suggested_tweak: Add a static manifest check (Section 5c) for windows.backgroundTasks EntryPoint that fails before the smoke launch, since registration failure is deterministic and cheap to detect statically.

failed_apis.why_tried: UWP sample declares 3 in-process background tasks (Geofence/Location/Visit) in Package.appxmanifest; the manifest was copied migrate-as-is.
failed_apis.root_cause: In a packaged WinUI 3 / Windows App SDK app, a non-audio background task declared with EntryPoint must have a matching windows.activatableClass.inProcessServer ActivatableClass registration; the UWP manifest has none, so AppX registration is rejected (0x80080204).
failed_apis.fix: Remove the windows.backgroundTasks <Extension> blocks from Package.appxmanifest (background tasks are not exercised by foreground parity and the C# BackgroundTaskBuilder code still compiles), OR add the matching windows.activatableClass.inProcessServer ActivatableClass entries.

doc_errors.wrong: Both enumerate the manifest requirements (TargetDeviceFamily, rescap, runFullTrust) as if that is the complete set, but omit that copied windows.backgroundTasks EntryPoint extensions block registration.
doc_errors.correct: The checklist must also reconcile <Extension Category="windows.backgroundTasks"> declarations, which fail with 0x80080204 unless removed or paired with an inProcessServer activatable class.

special_apis.special_handling: The C# code compiles under WinUI 3, but the manifest side is fundamentally different: a UWP in-process backgroundTasks EntryPoint is invalid in a packaged desktop manifest without an activatableClass.inProcessServer registration.

errors_encountered.error: 0x80080204 App manifest validation error: EntryPoint='BackgroundTask.GeofenceBackgroundTask' without ActivatableClassId in windows.activatableClass.inProcessServer (Package.appxmanifest line 31)
errors_encountered.root_cause: UWP windows.backgroundTasks extension copied verbatim into a packaged WinUI 3 manifest; the required in-process WinRT activatable-class registration is absent.
errors_encountered.fix: Strip the windows.backgroundTasks <Extension> blocks (default for foreground parity) or add the matching windows.activatableClass.inProcessServer ActivatableClass entries.

dev_agent_struggles.symptom: Manifest copied 'migrate-as-is' with UWP background-task extensions intact; build was clean so the agent believed it was done, but the app never launched.
dev_agent_struggles.turns_or_retries: Single pass — the defect was never surfaced because build succeeded and no launch verification flagged it.
dev_agent_struggles.root_cause: No guidance or validator check tells the agent that windows.backgroundTasks EntryPoint declarations are invalid in a packaged WinUI 3 manifest.
dev_agent_struggles.how_resolved: Not resolved during the trial — reached scoring as a hard launch failure (score 0/100).
dev_agent_struggles.preventable_by: A Validate-UwpMigration.ps1 static check that FAILs on windows.backgroundTasks EntryPoint extensions, plus a manifest-checklist item in MIGRATION-PATTERNS.md prescribing removal or inProcessServer registration.

missing_tooling.need: Static detection of manifest extensions that block AppX registration (windows.backgroundTasks EntryPoint) before the smoke launch.
missing_tooling.would_have_saved: The entire trial — a clean build masked a deterministic registration failure that zeroed the score.
